shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in a white shirt sits at the patio-side window seat and asks about tea preferences, while a man in a blue shirt sits at the sideboard-side window seat and a woman in a yellow shirt sits at the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the patio doors end, looking along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat and the sideboard in frame.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt states a preference against sugar, and the man in a white shirt questions the choice.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The man in a white shirt argues that sugar should be added to afternoon tea.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the patio-side window seat.

shots.content: The man in a blue shirt repeats the refusal, and the man in a white shirt insists that sugar must be added.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the dining table.
